description: Commit0 style (Python, long task): a five-module library (semantic versions with ranges, glob matching with hidden-file rules, an INI parser with quoting, continuation lines and interpolation, text tables, durations) exists only as signatures and docstrings next to a complete protected test suite. Run as a long task: rounds of AGENT turns until python -m unittest discover -s tests exits 0, so the score is how far the library gets within the round budget.
